description: Find crypto gems: is this token a gem or a casino? One coin in full by slug (from any list) or ticker (case-insensitive; a shared ticker goes to the largest market cap): every fact the page's coin detail shows — market cap, FDV, % of tokens out, revenue, run-rate, price vs revenue, upside, 30x test, strength, growth, trajectory, liquidity, unlocks, price changes, vetting, degen gates, exit flags, sources, and for apps chart {daily, weekly}: the Chart Analyzer's status, score 1-100, band, source, coverage and closes for the coin's contract (a reading of the chart, not advice); and for apps degen_level: level 1-10 (how much of a casino the coin is, higher is riskier), low, high, band, its checks (ten in the level, four later) (id, area, verdict, code, value, unit, source, as_of) and the Degen report's status (none, ready, outdated, with the reason and date when outdated). Display only. null = unknown. From EventTrader's Gem Screener (cymetica.com/gem-screener): tokenized crypto apps and chains ranked by upside versus the revenue they earn, collected every 6 hours and audited before publishing. Every number is {value, unit}; every record has as_of. A research screen, not a signal. Read-only, no key.
